name: vue-spa-kanban
title: Flowboard — Vue 3 kanban SPA
description: Client-only kanban board (Vue 3 + Vite 6 + Vue Router 4 history mode + Pinia + Tailwind 4) with mock login and role-guarded routes. Board and session live in localStorage; there is no backend at all.

auth.description: Client-side only. Login compares against hard-coded users in src/mocks/users.ts and stores a fake token + user in localStorage['flowboard.auth']. Vue Router beforeEach guards enforce requiresAuth (/board, /settings) and requiresAdmin (/admin) with redirect to /login?redirect=<path>. Nothing is enforced server-side.

persistence: browser localStorage only: flowboard.auth (session) and flowboard.board (columns + cards, seeded from src/mocks/board.ts on first visit)
notes: HTML5 history mode: the host MUST rewrite unknown paths to /index.html with status 200 (nginx: try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html — see nginx.conf; Netlify: public/_redirects; Vercel: vercel.json). Every route including /board/c-3 must return index.html; the SPA renders its own 404 view. Port 5019 is only the Vite dev server (npm run dev), not needed in production. `npm run build` runs vue-tsc type-checking first; use `npm run build-only` to skip it.
